_comment: DO NOT EDIT: Native Media Studio Pterodactyl import file.
name: Native Media Studio
author: jondunnigan
description: Self-hosted authorized media conversion workspace using yt-dlp and ffmpeg. Requires an external MySQL-compatible database.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Required MySQL-compatible connection string. The database must be reachable from the Pterodactyl node.

variables.name: Session Signing Secret
variables.description: Required random secret used to sign self-hosted application sessions. Generate at least 32 random bytes and keep it private.

variables.name: Media Work Directory
variables.description: Persistent directory for temporary authorized-media files. Keep the default on Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Migration Retry Attempts
variables.description: Number of startup attempts while waiting for the database.
